29 SEP SCHEDULE (night 3 + morning 2). The NIGHT list depends on probe 50 only, because probe 51 can read after the 23:30Z freeze (12:45Z + 10.9 h = 23:39Z).
Night by branch:

- R0/R-/R?: 00:05 exp88a, 00:06 exp75, 00:25 exp88b. All already PASSED; no new dummy.
Probe 51 sets BEST_CI: exp87a if R+ and 51 is + or 0u; none if R+ and 51 is 0 or - (non-additive); under R0/R-, exp83c only on a Q3 yes, else exp79a.
Morning:
- M1 is a CI stack of BEST_CI plus the arms that read + (lookup exp89a/b/c, exp89g/h/i, exp89m/n). It goes <= 09:30Z, or as soon as both arm reads land (~08:15Z).
- M2 is non-CI, <= 11:30Z: the FULL twin (exp89d / exp89j); else the next arm (exp88c if exp88a read -; exp89k RA90 if exp86c beat exp85a; exp89f); else unused, or an E10 copy with the user's yes.
Builds: all 14 exp89 commands were verified in a scratch mirror. Existing folders rebuild byte-identical; exp75 differs only by --set line order.
Lines to log: ledger rule exp89[abcghilmn] -> safetail_ci; the RA92+CI lift of W4 AMEND 3 (R+ only); the '0u' sub-rounding code; the exp86c forks waiver; the exp75 grandfather line.
GPU: R0/R- ~1-2 h, R+ ~2-2.5 h; both fit within ~4.5 h including the E10 reserve.
Expected gain: P(M1 new best) ~0.2, E ~+0.0002 display, private EV ~0. Nothing reaches R8, and there are no new disclosures this round.

  R+ and Q in {+, 0u} -> exp87a.

MORNING. P = the night arms that read '+' (known 07:05-08:15Z). exp75 reads ~09:30Z and is not stacked.

BEST_CI exp83c: {88a} exp89m, {88b} exp89n, both = exp83c + D25 + T7 (built on demand). If a two-arm file's dummy has not PASSED by 09:30Z, use the single-arm file with the higher display (tie: the 00:05Z arm). In every other case M1 becomes a non-CI file taken from the M2 list.
  M2 (non-CI; submit <= 11:30Z; reads 18:30-19:18Z).
    R0/R-: both arms '+' -> exp89d (exp70g + D25 + T7, the non-CI FULL twin); else exp88c (DISAPPEARANCE 1.75, the other direction) only if exp88a read '-'; else exp81 only if Q in {+, 0u} and Q3 = yes; else unused (or E10 with the user's yes).
    R+: both arms '+' -> exp89j (RA92 + D17); else exp89k (READMIT 0.90) only if exp86c read strictly above exp85a (AMEND 3 (4) RA90); else exp89f (exp85a + TAU 0.7). A second non-CI pick takes the next item.
  If the user ticks at 21:30Z or later, M2 may move to <= 13:00Z, but only for an approved E10 copy: no other information arrives between 11:00Z and 13:00Z.
MECHANISM. A one-knob arm on the non-CI twin reads ~2 h earlier than on a CI base (7.0-7.8 h vs 9.3-9.5 h). It is also read against a parent that is already scored, so attribution is clean. CI is a post-CSV coordinate shift, so an arm's topology change should stack with CI the way probe 48 did on exp70g.
EXPECTED GAIN. P(arm '+') ~0.2 each (our one-lever LB record: 2 '+' of ~11 reads vs parent, exp70g +0.002 and exp79a +0.001). P(at least 1 of 2 '+') = 1 - 0.8^2 = 0.36. P(stack additive) ~0.5-0.6, so P(M1 displays BEST + 0.001) ~0.2 and E[public display] ~+0.0002. A +0.001 moves our row past the ~42-team 0.957 block. Private EV ~0 +- 0.002 (winner's curse on one embryo).
RUNTIME. The arms change only an ILP objective weight or a gate threshold; they add no stage. Dummies ran 1,654-1,894 s under concurrency vs exp70g's 1,388-1,409 s solo. Hidden L: non-CI ~7.0-7.8 h, CI ~9.3-9.8 h (< 10.75 h admit).
GATE. Dummy (R22-A1 / rule v2) + the public read vs its parent. Nothing reaches the R8 lab bar: R8 is lifted by the user, and these are public-read tests only.

findings.what:
SUB-ROUNDING TIE CODE '0u' for reads that tie our best display (0.957). Kaggle ranks on the unrounded score, and exact ties go to the earlier submission. A new 0.957 file therefore moves our row up only if its unrounded score beats exp79a's. Apply the existing UP test (one completion between snapshots) in three places:
(i) Probe 50 at 0.957: an UP means exp85a > exp79a unrounded. That decides whether the non-CI or the CI file is BEST for the finals card.
(ii) Probe 51 at 0.957: an UP means the stack beat exp79a, so it is not non-additive (Q = 0u, the base for M1).
(iii) R+ night arms on exp85a that read the parent's display.
No UP means an honest '0'. Expected gain: it resolves ~1/3 of reads (P(display = 0.957) ~0.3-0.4 for 50/51) that would otherwise be coded non-additive. Runtime 0. Gate: the uptest.py record (S0/S1 counts differ by exactly 1).
